Paper summary: The paper proposes "SamplePairing," a data augmentation technique for image classification that synthesizes new training samples by averaging two randomly selected images from the training set, while retaining the label of the first image. The authors demonstrate that this simple method significantly improves validation accuracy on ILSVRC 2012, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and SVHN, particularly when the training set size is limited. The paper includes a description of the training protocol involving intermittent disabling of the augmentation and a final fine-tuning phase.
